rule_interactions.interaction: Engine model year 2007 is below the model year 2014 minimum that Subrule 34-1101 requires to complete DTR registration.
DTR registration is required for entry onto any Port Authority terminal; see reg_panynj_dtr_engine for the engine-year condition on completing that registration.

rule_interactions.interaction: Gross weight 90,000 lbs exceeds the 80,000 lb maximum overall gross weight stated in the guidebook.
90,000 lbs equals the Table 5 maximum gross weight permitted under an annual Ocean Borne Container Permit for sealed ocean containers of legal dimensions.
A single-trip OS/OW permit is the alternative permit path for a non-divisible load above legal weight limitations.
Gross vehicle weight 90,000 lbs is within the 128,000 lb maximum for containerized shipments on marine terminal highways.
